CREATE TABLE `analytics_events` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`eventType` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
	`userId` int,
	`sessionId` varchar(255),
	`eventData` json,
	`ipAddress` varchar(45),
	`userAgent` text,
	`country` varchar(2),
	`city` varchar(100),
	`device` varchar(50),
	`browser` varchar(50),
	`os` varchar(50),
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `analytics_events_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `client_reviews` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`projectId` int,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`rating` int NOT NULL,
	`comment` text NOT NULL,
	`status` enum('pending','approved','rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
	`publishedAt` timestamp,
	`moderatedBy` int,
	`moderatedAt` timestamp,
	`moderationComment` text,
	`consultantResponse` text,
	`consultantRespondedAt` timestamp,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `client_reviews_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `roadmap_items` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`description` text NOT NULL,
	`status` enum('backlog','planned','in_progress','completed','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'backlog',
	`priority` enum('low','medium','high','critical') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
	`category` varchar(100),
	`votes` int DEFAULT 0,
	`estimatedDate` timestamp,
	`completedAt` timestamp,
	`createdBy` int,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `roadmap_items_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

ALTER TABLE `analytics_events` ADD CONSTRAINT `analytics_events_userId_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE `client_reviews` ADD CONSTRAINT `client_reviews_projectId_projects_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`projectId`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE `client_reviews` ADD CONSTRAINT `client_reviews_userId_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE `client_reviews` ADD CONSTRAINT `client_reviews_moderatedBy_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`moderatedBy`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;
ALTER TABLE `roadmap_items` ADD CONSTRAINT `roadmap_items_createdBy_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`createdBy`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE no action ON UPDATE no action;
